title: Anna's Home
text:
My friend Anna has a small house in a quiet village. The house is yellow and it has a big green garden. There are two red chairs under a tree. Anna likes to sit there in the evening.

Her cat is black and white. The cat is very friendly and it likes to sleep in the sun. Anna is happy with her home.

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her home?
What kind of place is Anna's village probably like?

vocabulary.definition: kind and pleasant to be with
a piece of land with plants, next to a house
a small place where people live, smaller than a town

paragraph_translations: Moja przyjaciółka Anna ma mały dom w cichej wiosce. Dom jest żółty i ma duży zielony ogród. Pod drzewem stoją dwa czerwone krzesła. Anna lubi tam siedzieć wieczorem.
Jej kot jest czarno-biały. Kot jest bardzo przyjazny i lubi spać na słońcu. Anna jest zadowolona ze swojego domu.
